Mick made a claim for SPC on 5.1.11. When making his claim Mick told the DM that his house was up for sale and that he had savings of £3,000. Despite this information (see DMG 83041), the DM set an AIP for 5 years. On 9.3.11 Mick informs the DM that he has moved address because he has sold his house and bought a flat. He also now has capital of £25,000 left from the proceeds of the sale of the house after buying the flat. When looking at the circumstances of the case, the DM realises that an AIP should not have been set. The DM revises the decision setting an AIP on the grounds of official error (see DMG Chapter 03).
